name: THEMCLIFE SMP | Towny Survival Build a town. Live a life. - Java & Bedrock
description:
Hey! We're THEMCLIFE SMP, a small, friendly Towny survival server that Java and Bedrock players share.

**What you'll find**

- **Towns and nations** - claim land, build with friends, wage town wars with a weekly warscore

- **Custom bosses, dungeons and a server raid every Saturday night** - everyone who helps shares the loot

- **A hand-built spawn town** - market, tavern, arena with duels and betting, parkour, dungeon hall

- **mcMMO skills, auction house, chest shops** and a player economy

- **Free daily vote rewards** and login streaks

- **No pay-to-win** - supporter perks are cosmetic and convenience only, never a PvP edge

**How to join**

- Java: `themclifesmp.com` (26.3, older versions welcome)

- Bedrock: `themclifesmp.com`, port `19132` (console and mobile work)

- Discord: https://discord.gg/EJz5xQSNme

Happy to answer questions in the comments. See you in town!
